headline: Rain clears Saturday — harvest onions, tip canes.
weather_notes: Skip all watering through Friday — 0.31 in fell today and 50%+ rain chance Friday keeps soil saturated.
Harvest w4 onions by Saturday morning — two days of rain accelerates neck rot on mature bulbs still in the ground.
Wait until Saturday to dig potato bags — let containers drain; Saturday's clear 85°F is the week's cleanest digging window.
Inspect c1 dry bean pods Saturday — repeated rain events this week risk mold on pods drying on the vine.
